patch_description:
This revision uses a robust, endpoint-aligned adaptive trend tracker with explicit multi-scale trend consistency. A recency-weighted robust local-linear fit supplies a low-lag level estimate, while a second short-horizon slope estimate determines whether recent dynamics agree with the broader trend.

High adaptation gains are allowed only when full-window and recent-window slopes have consistent sign and comparable magnitude. When trend evidence is mixed, gains are capped to avoid reactive noise following. Innovations are robustly clipped using MAD noise estimates, and direction reversals require persistent, significant evidence before being confirmed. This reduces noise-induced reversals and slope changes while retaining rapid response during coherent genuine turns.

The public functions, arguments, return values, output alignment, and code outside the evolution block are retained.
